q: Choose the correct passive form: 'Mother was preparing food.'
o: Food was prepared by mother.
Food was being prepared by mother.
Food is being prepared by mother.
Food had been prepared by mother.
e:
Active বাক্যটি Past Continuous Tense-এর। এর Passive হয় Object + was/were + being + V3 + by + Subject। অতএব Food was being prepared by mother শুদ্ধ। অন্য বিকল্পে Tense বদলে গেছে বলে ভুল।
মনে রাখুন:
Continuous Tense-এর Passive-এ being সবসময় থাকে।
উদাহরণ: They are repairing the road → The road is being repaired by them।

q: Choose the correct active form: 'Were you seen by him?'
o: Was he seen by you?
Does he see you?
Had he seen you?
Did he see you?
e:
Passive বাক্যটি Past Simple-এর Interrogative রূপ (Were ... seen)। Active করতে Past Simple-এর প্রশ্নবোধক গঠন নিতে হয়: Did + Subject + V1। by him-এর him হয়ে যায় Subject he, আর you হয় Object। তাই Did he see you?
মনে রাখুন:
Past Simple Question Active: Did + S + V1 + O?

q: People say that good things come to those who wait. (Make it passive)
o: Good things are said to come to those who wait.
It is said that good things come to those who wait.
Those who wait are said to have good things come to them.
People said that good things come to those who wait.
e: Active বাক্য People say that... দিয়ে শুরু হলে passive হয় It is said that... গঠনে। People ও say-এর মতো stative verb (know, think, say, find, understand) থাকলে নিয়ম: It is বা was + said + that + অবশিষ্ট clause অপরিবর্তিত। তাই It is said that good things come to those who wait সঠিক। Complex বা compound sentence-এ দুটি clause-এর voice এক রাখা হয়, কিন্তু এখানে that-clause যেমন ছিল তেমনই থাকে।
